package nextbestaction

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type Get struct {
	Enabled bool
	Actions repository.StudentNextActionReader
}

func (useCase Get) Execute(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TeacherNextAction, error) {
	if !useCase.Enabled {
		return domain.TeacherNextAction{}, domain.ErrNextBestActionDisabled
	}
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(studentID)
	if err != nil || parsed.String() != studentID {
		return domain.TeacherNextAction{}, domain.ErrInvalidNextBestActionRequest
	}
	if useCase.Actions == nil {
		return domain.TeacherNextAction{}, domain.ErrNextBestActionStateUnavailable
	}
	action, err := useCase.Actions.GetNextAction(ctx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherNextAction{}, errors.Join(domain.ErrNextBestActionStateUnavailable, err)
	}
	action, err = domain.NormalizeTeacherNextAction(action)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherNextAction{}, errors.Join(domain.ErrNextBestActionStateUnavailable, err)
	}
	return action, nil
}
